newAlternativeSource.title: Jurien Bay — Harbour Entrance
newAlternativeSource.story: An alternative official refreshed still looks across Jurien Bay harbour entrance and its rock breakwaters. Water, a channel marker, foreshore vegetation and a distant shoreline are visible, but foreground scaffolding and stairs block much of the right-hand view. Use this limited harbour window alongside the coastal camera, not as a clear panorama or evidence of safe navigation, boat departures, wildlife or public access. Check the image clock and current marine notices; archive frames can be older.
